purpose: Select whether a signed-scribble strong unary should be spatially propagated using only deterministic out-of-fold reference evidence, before freezing any new target-view score.

candidate_actions.name: strong_unary
candidate_actions.definition: balanced logistic probability on normalized hash256 relation rows, transformed by the fixed regularizer exponent P^(1/4), without graph reachability masking

candidate_actions.name: hash256_fixed_f2_g4_k201_diffusion
candidate_actions.definition: the same strong unary followed by the frozen release-compatible f=2, g=4, K201, 100-iteration query-conditioned graph reachability mask

common_method.track: strict raw positive and negative scribbles
common_method.reference_evidence: signed exact W-transpose scribble divided by W-transpose-one
common_method.relation: query-independent official C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive signed multiplicative hash256 diagnostic
common_method.relation_role: not native DINOv2 and not an exact LUDVIG feature match
common_method.classifier: sklearn balanced LogisticRegression C=0.01 fit only on nonzero training-fold signed evidence and weighted by primitive responsibility
common_method.diffusion_kernel: released N-by-K positional normalization, symmetrization, and per-iteration feature-column normalization

cross_validation.population: all capability-valid primitive rows with nonzero signed reference evidence
cross_validation.leakage_rule: set every held-out row's signed evidence to exact zero before logistic fitting, positive-reference bandwidth statistics, query gating, and diffusion
cross_validation.heldout_prediction_rule: score each held-out nonzero anchor before any direct hard-anchor overwrite
cross_validation.aggregation: one strict out-of-fold prediction per observed primitive, pooled across all three folds

selection.primary_metric: responsibility-weighted balanced binary log-loss with positive and negative responsibility mass normalized to one half each
selection.decision: lexicographically minimize rounded balanced log-loss, then maximize rounded weighted AUC, then prefer strong_unary on an exact tie
selection.uniformity: the identical rule is executed independently for every query; scene identity and previous target behavior are not inputs

final_refit.rule: after selection, refit the same classifier on all nonzero signed reference rows
final_refit.invalid_capability_rows: zero except exact direct exclusive anchors

sentinel_plan.gate: strict macro improves by at least 0.03 over frozen compact unary, at least one sentinel improves, and neither regresses by more than 0.03
